qualifications: The all-case goal remains open. Latest complete sweep measured 1,368 passes, 675 skips, 2,569 failures, 115 timeouts, and no crashes out of 4,727. Focused gains do not establish a new full-suite total.

One nonblocking CLOEXEC inotify descriptor uses the pinned libuv masks and event projection. Kernel groups preserve first-path basename and subscriber order. One callback dispatch per checkpoint observes closure and subscription changes between deliveries. Active watchers hold one root, stopped handles retain one reference bit without keeping the loop alive, and weak handle records are pruned by the shared collector.

Native close transfers out live ownership and queues the public close event through the canonical next-tick queue. Abort listeners detach on close. Cleanup and replacement VM bootstrap close the native descriptor and discard old state. Captured handle reference metadata matches Node after close.

Five new oracles cover real file events and shared subscriptions, Buffer filenames, public metadata and references, close/abort/pre-abort behavior, missing-path error fields/order and dormant handles, actual unref/ref subprocess exit, inherited option copying/getter counts/nonenumerable shadows/ignored symbol getters, invalid encodings and ignore values, function/RegExp/simple wildcard filtering, original listener/filter exceptions, and GC safety. All 125 API oracles, 577 runtime tests, and 43 framework cases passed on committed source.

The initial missing-file oracle caught errno/syscall/code order. A facade naming change then caused recursion and two timeouts; the native dispatcher parameter was renamed before qualification. Ignore validation oracle caught missing array-index names; fixed before qualification. Retained group outcomes are from the corrected implementation.

Watch group reached 11 passes out of 37 with zero lost passes versus the latest complete sweep. All seven VFS watch fixtures retained their passes. The immutable-options fixture remains failing at the missing fs.watchFile method; it is not substituted or counted as a gain.

Mounted virtual paths retain their existing VFS route, while unmounted Linux paths use the native watcher. Other platforms retain their prior fallback. Internal test uv errno constants now derive from the same platform table as util.getSystemErrorName. No fixture identity, score, workload marker, or oracle backend is used in production behavior.

Recursive watches, stat-based watchFile, async-iterator watching, advanced glob semantics, complete handle-wrap/proxy/error details, and other API gaps remain open. String wildcard compilation is shared with the existing Rust path matcher and occurs at creation. Captured intrinsic RegExp operations preserve lastIndex and avoid a replaced public exec method.

Affected groups and measurements ran sequentially without overlapping compilation or guest checks. Exact frozen sibling hashes and source provenance are retained; compiled runner metadata may identify the parent publication before source commit.

All eight fixed-work fixtures and Richards are iteration diagnostics, one round with no matched production qualification or speed claim. Hardware instruction/cycle counters remain unavailable on this host (previous perf_event_open ENOENT); no substitutes. Empty-script samples retain actual wait4 RSS and alternating order.
